notes: s005 τῆς, the second attributive article following its noun, is unrepresented because the ASV supplies no relative clause for the verbless prepositional modifier (rule 31's closing clause).
s010 διέταξα heads on order rather than gave, the support verb carrying none of the lexeme (rules 17, 91).
s015/s016 follow rule 100: οὕτως takes the whole correlative so and the separate καί takes the word the ASV wrote for it, also.
